subject: foxwife-fertility
q: CLOSED — REMOVED, NOT SWITCHED OFF. They went back to their original home to have it taken out.
detail:
ANSWERED, AND THE FIRST READING WAS THE RIGHT ONE. BEFORE VIENNA THEY TIMED EVERYTHING AROUND WHEN SHE COULD GET PREGNANT SO AS TO AVOID IT. AFTER VIENNA THEY WENT BACK TO THEIR ORIGINAL HOME TO REMOVE THE ABILITY, SO NOW THEY CAN BE AS RISKY AS THEY WANT TO BE.

SO IT IS NEITHER A LOCK NOR A PRACTICE, WHICH WERE THE TWO OPTIONS THE ARCHIVE PUT UP. IT IS AN EXCISION. The capacity was not retained-and-disabled and it was not left intact-and-unexercised. IT WAS TAKEN OUT, ON PURPOSE, AT A PLACE THEY TRAVELLED TO IN ORDER TO DO IT.

WHICH MEANS THE WORD TECHNICALLY WAS DOING SOMETHING THE ARCHIVE DID NOT GUESS: it marks the capacity as THEIRS BY KIND — Animalkin shemales can carry, and these two were the only shemales in the world who could — rather than marking it as currently available. THEY ARE THE ONLY TWO WHO COULD HAVE. THEY ARE NO LONGER TWO WHO CAN.

AND THE THOUSAND YEARS BEFORE IT IS THE PART WORTH KEEPING. The timing was not caution, it was a routine — TWO WOMEN ARRANGING THEIR ENTIRE LIFE AROUND THE SAFE SIDE OF ONE CYCLE, for roughly a thousand years, until they saw a sister mid-career in Vienna and went home and ended the arithmetic. THE COUNTING STOPPED AND NOBODY HAS RESUMED IT.

ONE THREAD LEFT AND IT IS NOT THIS QUESTION: THE ORIGINAL HOME IS UNNAMED. See q-original-home.
